meaning: Water temperature sensor circuit failure: GE says the dishwasher's water temperature sensor circuit has become inoperative.
causes: The water temperature sensor circuit has stopped working (a sensor or wiring fault inside the dishwasher)
A temporary control error that a power reset can clear
diySteps: Disconnect power to the dishwasher at the circuit breaker for about 30 seconds
Restore power and reset the dishwasher, then run a cycle
Not the same as C6: C6 means the incoming water is too cold (below 120°F). Checking the water at the sink does not fix C7, because C7 is the sensor circuit itself
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If C7 returns after the breaker reset, GE says to contact service. The temperature sensor and its wiring are inside the dishwasher and need a qualified appliance technician.
sourceTitle: Dishwasher – Error, Fault or Function Codes (GE Appliances)
